metadata.description: Retrieve the object definitions for a specified media type within an app.
metadata.learn_more: Retrieve the object definitions for a specified media type within an app. This endpoint allows you to access the settings related to the object definitions of various media types such as VIDEO, AUDIO, DOCUMENT, OTHER, and IMAGE. It is useful for understanding the structure and properties associated with different media types in your application.

appId.label: App Id
appId.description: The unique identifier of the app for which the object definitions are being retrieved.

mediaType.label: Media Type
mediaType.description: The type of media for which the object definitions are being retrieved. Valid values are VIDEO, AUDIO, DOCUMENT, OTHER, and IMAGE.

includeFullDefinition.label: Include Full Definition
includeFullDefinition.description: A boolean indicating whether to include the full definition of the object. If true, the response will contain more detailed information.
